cover_letter:
Dear XFA Team,

When I read your job posting for a Marketing & Content Creator, I felt an immediate connection. You're looking for a creative maker who can harness AI for efficiency while keeping a human touch—that's exactly how I approach my work. I'm a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, and I've been building my own AI-driven workflows to automate busywork and focus on what matters: creating content that resonates.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and I write keyword-targeted blog content that grows organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. On my own project, mirook.com, I've implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines—a skill that's directly relevant to your AI-driven marketing engine.

I'm a maker at heart. I can jump between a video editing timeline, a HubSpot workflow, and an SEO dashboard in the same afternoon. I'm proactive, scrappy, and comfortable working autonomously. I'm also fluent in English, with Dutch at B1 and Turkish native, and I'm eager to travel to events across Europe.

I'm excited about the opportunity to shape XFA's brand and learn the skills of the future. I'd love to bring my blend of technical and creative skills to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
